notes: No task anywhere in the pool implements a transformer, a BPE tokenizer, or reads a real TF checkpoint - this query has no bullseye. I decomposed it into four transferable skills and scored on those: (a) implement a numerical/ML algorithm from scratch in dependency-free C built with gcc -O3 -lm (TMax is deep here - task_000042/000295/000513/000794/000815 and more); (b) reimplement/reconstruct a model to match a reference exactly (task_000650, task_000333); (c) parse a binary format field-by-field to spec (the d0c-s4vage pfp family in SWE-Rebench is the best in the whole pool for this, better than anything in TMax, so pfp-112 is in the final top 10); (d) optimise under a byte budget (rare - task_000624 golfs to <=65 bytes; the retrievers surfaced almost nothing for 'byte limit / code golf', that axis is essentially absent from the corpora). task_000816 (numerically stable log-softmax over attention scores) is the single most domain-relevant task found and came from my own search, not the shortlist. SWE-Smith and SWE-Rebench task_form will rarely match (bug-fix vs build-from-spec) and I did not inflate it; they earn their places on the binary-parsing and numerics skills. RTS is by far the weakest corpus for this query - its embedding/CADE and .npy-cleaning families are surface 'embedding/model' matches with no implementation content, so several RTS entries are honestly scored 1-2 and should not be picked over any TMax C-implementation task.
